entities.summary: Mehmed II, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Rise of the Ottoman Empire (1453–1453). Preceded by Fall of Constantinople and Battle of Ankara — Timur defeats Bayezid I, nearly destroying the empire. Their legacy influenced Siege of Vienna — high-water mark of Ottoman expansion into Europe and Mimar Sinan builds the Süleymaniye Mosque — his Istanbul masterpiece.
